source.title: Composer ™ for Harmony Function Code Application Manual Volume 1 (Function Codes 1 to 174)

name: Blink
description: The blink function code generates a pulsating output signal. When <S1> and <S2> are logic 1, the output toggles between logic 1 and logic 0. The duration of either the logic 0 or logic 1 state is dependent on the cycle time of the block. The duration of either logic state is limited to be no less than 0.2 second. Output N equals <S1> until <S1> and <S2> equal one, then output N blinks. Refer to Table 61-1 for all possible output values.
